nodes.label: fuser (FUSE for Rust)
nodes.author: Christopher Berner
nodes.rationale: A rewrite of the FUSE C library rather than bindings, replacing libfuse between the kernel driver and the userspace implementation so a developer gets Rust's type interface and runtime; on Linux the mount/umount libfuse calls are optional and removable via the libfuse feature flag. Forked from the zargony fuse crate to continue development past ABI 7.19.
